description: Post a review on a pull request: approve to approve changes, request_changes to request revisions (body required), or comment for general feedback. Only an open pull request can be approved or have changes requested, and GitHub does not let an author approve their own pull request or request changes on it. Line comments can be attached: path and line in the new version (or side left for a removed line), and start_line for a multi-line range. Pass head_sha to ensure the review posts only on the commit that was reviewed; if new commits arrived, the call fails without posting. A pull request is 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL; a bare number means the working tree's repository, or repo.

body.description: The review text. Required for request_changes and for comment without line comments; optional for approve.

comments.description: Optional array of up to 50 line comments.

body.description: The line comment text, in Markdown.

line.description: The line number in the diff to comment on.

path.description: The file path the line comment is on.

side.description: Which side of the diff: right for the new version (default), left for the old one.

start_line.description: The start line of a multi-line comment range (must be less than line).

event.description: The review action: approve, request_changes, or comment.

head_sha.description: Optional 40-character commit SHA the review was based on. Fails if new commits arrived.

pr.description: The pull request, as 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL.

repo.description: owner/name; defaults to the working tree's repository (its origin). Used for a bare number.

name: github_pr_review

comments.description: How many line comments were posted with the review.

commit.description: The commit SHA the review was posted on.

title: Review a GitHub pull request
